build_dataset_istella: build a tensorflow dataset builder for istella learning-to-rank datasets with main, s, and x variants
create_istella_config: create an istella builder config with validation split and subdirectory options
run_istella_split_generators: run istella split generators to download and extract train, test, and optional validation splits
run_istella_generate_examples: run istella example generator to parse libsvm-format ranking data with latin1 encoding
review_istella_info: review the istella dataset info method that defines float_features, label, query_id, and doc_id schema
